pages.title: What AiAlgoDesk does
pages.description: Charts, an option chain, alerts and paper trading for Indian markets, explained in plain words.
pages.intro: One place to read the market, practise your own ideas on paper and keep a record of how you trade.

sections.heading: Read the market
lines: Charts with price structure drawn for you: swings, trend and the areas where price turned before.
An option chain with open interest and the key numbers explained in plain words.
Sector and index views so you see the whole market at a glance.

sections.heading: Practise your own ideas
lines: An idea library that explains each method in plain words, with a scan you can try.
Trading bots that follow the idea and settings you chose, at real prices with pretend money.
Signals described in structure words, never as advice.

sections.heading: Stay in control
lines: Your own risk settings: the most one trade may lose and a daily loss limit.
A journal that records every paper trade so you can review it.
Alerts in the app and on your own Telegram.

pages.title: How it works
pages.description: Connect your broker for prices, pick an idea, set your own settings and practise on paper.
pages.intro: Four steps from your first visit to your first reviewed paper trade.

sections.heading: Connect your broker
lines: ATP reads prices through your own broker account. Your broker login stays with your broker.

sections.heading: Pick an idea
lines: Choose a method from the idea library, or describe your own, and set it up with your own settings.

sections.heading: Practise on paper
lines: A trading bot watches the market for the structure you chose. No order reaches your broker.

sections.heading: Review and learn
lines: Every paper trade lands in your journal. Review it, change one setting at a time and practise again.

pages.title: About AiAlgoDesk
pages.description: A trading workspace for retail traders in India: education, analysis and paper practice.
pages.intro: AiAlgoDesk is built for traders who want to learn to read the market by its structure and practise with discipline.

sections.heading: What we believe
lines: Learning comes before real money. Every idea should be practised on paper first.
The decisions stay with you: the idea, the settings, the trade and the exit.

sections.heading: What we do not do
lines: We do not tell anyone what to trade and we make no promise about results.
Most individual traders in futures and options lose money. Please read the risk disclosure before you trade.
